Another part of this patch is USDT-related feature probing:
- BPF cookie support detection from user-space;
- detection of kernel support for auto-refcounting of USDT semaphore.
The latter is optional. If kernel doesn't support such feature and USDT
doesn't rely on USDT semaphores
column2: no error is returned. But if libbpf

column1: detects that USDT requires setting semaphores and kernel doesn't support
this

column1: support poking process's memory directly to increment semaphore value
like BCC does on legacy kernels
column2: due to inherent raciness and danger of

Logistically
